concept: Track Diagram trued against every fault its judges named. The family's week is still a signal box's illuminated track diagram: steel lines on green-black slate, a lamp at every stop, the times hung in a timetable margin, and a line only where there is an order. Home has three lines (setup, Coming up, To do) and Chat one; every other list, on every page, is a one-line row on a slate board, with its heads set as column heads. The tube's own light is back on the short list of live things only: the mark, the lit word 'plan', Send and each page's one green key, the box, the lamps, the run of track from now (a wake travelling along it), the greeting's pool and the monitors, each in the original's layered halo. The rest is matte: slate, steel, the page-head rings and the family's square plates.
companions: Steel #9fc2da (a breath more chroma than the parent's #a7c4d8) is the diagram's wiring and the family's hand: underlined links, the latched 'here' key's cap and lamp, the latched filter keys, the family's chat plates (a 3px bar facing their initial), today's filled date key on the month (#879dae to #748a9b), and the 12% wash of every row's afterglow. Slate is the material: #0f1519 trays for reading, #161c20 raised boxes with #2e343b edges for acting, #26313a for a latched cell, and the page-head ring is a slate disc with a rim in its page's colour. Pewter #8794a2 draws a lamp that is off or not set up; red is kept for what has stopped. Amber #ffb850 means late or needs a look: words, filled lamps, the setup tray's #644e29 edge and a 4px bar, never a fill; its only other appearance is a restaurant's ring and kind word, as every kind colour appears. Kind colours live in the ring lamp and the kind's word only. Sage #86d9a6 is the lit edge of a row's afterglow, the box being written in and a ticked box, matte, with no halo. Pink moved from #ff9fd0 to #ff9dd6 so the steel and the wishes' pink stay apart for protan sight (5.3). The cobalt corner wash is gone (washGlow 0).
decisions: Light on the live list only, now to the letter: the page-head ring on Ideas, Plans, To do, Status, Settings and the forms is matte (a slate disc, a 1.5px rim of its page's colour mixed into the rail, no halo, no scanlines, no drop-shadow on the icon), and the head's elbow is a square signal-box corner. Only Chat's ring, her live screen, stays lit, so the one green key at the right of a head is the only light there. A ticked box is flat sage.

Home has three lines and is 1648px at 1280. Lately added, the kids' lists and 'Something to eat' are one-line rows with ring lamps and no fills. 'Something to eat' is now the list's last row under a hairline: an amber ring as every restaurant has, 'Something to eat' in 15px label grey, '2 restaurants to try' at 17/600 and a steel arrow, so amber on Home means late or needs a look. The kids' wishes left the left column for a full-width tray under the desk, their rows set in the desk's own two columns (1.2fr/1fr, 4.125rem apart), so Maya's row stands under To do and Theo's under Lately added, and the two desk trays end within 7px of each other.

Coming up is kept exactly as drawn: 34px DM Mono day numerals over 17/600 plate titles, OCT and SUN stacked at 13px, 'in 4 days' on one line, the word 'now' lit above the one breathing lamp, a 3.8rem occupied run that fades into the steel before the first stop, a 12px white-hot wake sliding along it every 4s (still under reduced motion), and the rail ending on the last lamp.

Home's To do is a timetable with an 8.5rem margin headed 'Due': amber '3 days ago' and '2 days ago' beside filled amber lamps, the steady lit NOW lamp with 'now' and its lit run, then 'tomorrow · 19:56'. Rows are one line: a square well (its 44px target pulled back into the row), the title at 17/600, WHO at the right. The head reads 'To do', '2 late' as an amber link to the open list, then 'All 4 →'.

The To do page: 'Add something to do' is the green primary on the title's baseline and the fold's own summary. One control row: four latched Show keys, the Search field and its key, and the list's figure '4 open' closing the row as Ideas' '12 ideas' does. The list's heads are column heads on the row's own grid: DUE hung right over the margin's stamps, then TASK, WHO and WHEN in 13px label caps over a hairline, as on Ideas; the edit column is a fixed 4.6rem so the heads line up exactly. Rows: tick, '#4', title, person icon and name, 'was due 3 days ago' in amber or 'due tomorrow, 19:56', a 44px pencil Edit key whose form opens across the row. 'Up to 100 are shown.' moved into the footnote. On the phone a row is two lines (what; then who and when in words), the pencil alone is the key (its word still read out), and the Add key sits under the lede instead of over the title.

Ideas is a listing: latched All ideas / Restaurants keys with the 'Save a thought for later' disclosure key and '12 ideas' at the right; one filter row of base-select pickers with a secondary Filter key, and no restaurant in the Kind picker. The heads are IDEA (over the ring and the name together), FOR, DRIVE (standing over the minutes, not the compass letter) and #. Ten rows above the fold at 1280x900; the radar tube on a thin case at the right, '[18 MIN NW]' held together. The Restaurants key's own page is now the same listing (it was still a card grid): ring lamp, name and today's hours, where, how far, for whom and rating in dim, and the ways out (Everything we know, Their site, Book a table, Map) at the right, under them on the phone.

Status opens on the spend tube beside its sentence and 'Change the limit'. The three columns are trays of one-line rows (lamp, name 17/600, detail 15 dim). Who answers keeps its chain, lit lamp to lamp, ending at 'If that one cannot'. 'No key' and 'not configured' are pewter rings. 'This page', which Settings marks 'Needs a look', now shows the needs-a-look bar, so the legend's fourth state appears on the page it explains. The legend holds each lamp to its own word (a pair to a span, 1.6rem between pairs). The cost tables' heads are 13px label caps like every column head, their figures 13px DM Mono.

Every monitor is a thin case: a 3px graphite bezel, 14px outside and 11px glass, a hairline lip, a 12px chin with eight vent ticks and E12's power lamp, and the 80px spill, at screenGlow 1.0. Sign in and the 404 keep power-on from opacity .05 and the flicker.

Every place is named in words at every width. From 68rem the bar's words are 15px; from 52 to 68rem they are 13px with tighter keys; on the phone the four at the top carry a 13px word under the icon, as the tabs do (13px there too). Below 68rem the wordmark folds to the mark and its cursor to make room, the name still read out. 'Here' is a latched #26313a cell reaching the bar's rule, its 2px steel cap on the rule with a 7px lamp at the centre; on the phone's tab bar the same cell with the cap on top.

Chat keeps the line from her screen down the gutter to the lit ring at the box.
